name: Polynomial chaos expansion (PCE)
domain: 结构可靠度与随机分析
definition_zh: 用正交多项式展开随机响应的表示方法。
usage_overview: 用于建立随机输入与结构响应之间的近似关系，通过正交随机多项式及确定性系数构建概率分析代理模型，支持性能函数统计矩的计算和结构可靠度的近似评估，包括抗连续倒塌可靠性分析。

complete_examples.text: Fortunately, the widespread application of meta models such as the polynomial chaos expansion (PCE) in the field of uncertainty provides new ideas for estimating the statistical moments of response functions.
An alternative approach is to use the polynomial chaos expansion (PCE) [38], which is derived based on a set of orthogonal stochastic polynomials.
The Polynomial Chaos Expansion (PCE) is a novel non-sampling-based reliability analysis method and can be used to perform the randomness quantification of a dynamical system.
